items.title: Neal Caine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: you just got a big compliment from David Torkanowsky about a Frank Sinatra 100th birthday observance, a big band

ctx.x: Neal was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on September 26, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Neal Caine here, bassist and, you just got a big compliment from David Torkanowsky about a Frank Sinatra 100th birthday observance, a big band. And he said you really kicked some butt with your bass that night.
